description: Cases for the canonical JSON profile (BUILD_SPEC_0 section 4). For each entry in `cases`, encoding `value` must give exactly `canonical_utf8` (and these bytes in hex). For each entry in `rejected`, encoding `value` must FAIL. Every SDK language must match every case.

cases.name: a double quote in a string
a quote and a backslash together
a string that is only a space
slash and tilde are not escaped
strings that look like numbers stay strings

rejected.name: an integer just above the limit
an integer just below the limit
